reviews.title: so far I've used Wise for sending funds…
reviews.text: so far I've used Wise for sending funds to friends or family and sometimes to exchange currency. Wise is reasonable simple to use and fast and that is all that counts.

reviews.replyText:
Hey Erik, That really is what matters most! 💚 We're so glad Wise has made sending money to loved ones and exchanging currencies fast and simple for you.
